verdict.rationale: Twenty is a CRM platform, so publishing an official MCP server is a fair axis. Its first-party pricing page lists "MCP server | Yes" across all tiers, which supports an official server, but nothing in the pack explains how to connect an agent, what tools are exposed, or how auth works. missing for 10: MCP server setup/connection documentation, description of exposed tools and auth scoping, independent or hands-on corroboration of connecting an external agent.
